# Bundled presentation assets

These assets are served locally. No CDN, font service, or package installation
is contacted when visitors open Commit Monster or when the static site builds.

- Codicons 0.0.36, by Microsoft Corporation. The stylesheet and font are
  unmodified copies of
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@vscode/codicons@0.0.36/dist/codicon.css` and
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@vscode/codicons@0.0.36/dist/codicon.ttf`.
  The icon license is included in `codicons/LICENSE` (CC BY 4.0), and the
  code license is included in `codicons/LICENSE-CODE` (MIT).
- Press Start 2P, by the Press Start 2P Project Authors, served as v16 by
  Google Fonts. The font is an unmodified copy of
  `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/pressstart2p/v16/e3t4euO8T-267oIAQAu6jDQyK0nS.ttf`.
  Its SIL Open Font License is included in `press-start-2p/OFL.txt`.

Review any updates before replacing these pinned copies. The application does
not install or execute any code from these packages.
